info.description:
Backend API for **CholoBangladesh**, a tourist platform where travellers find and book verified local guides.

## Roles
| Role | Who | How they sign up |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | Tourist (foreign or local) | **Email OTP** (3 steps), or **Google / Apple** (1 step). No phone needed and no SMS cost. |
| `guide` | Local guide | **Bangladeshi mobile OTP** (3 steps), then profile + **NID/selfie KYC**, which an admin approves |
| `admin` | Platform staff | Created from the `ADMIN_EMAIL` / `ADMIN_PASSWORD` env vars |

## Response envelope (every endpoint)
```json
// success
{ "success": true,  "message": "logged in", "data": { ... }, "request_id": "..." }
// error
{ "success": false, "message": "human readable", "error": { "code": "OTP_INVALID", "details": { "remaining_attempts": 3 }, "retry_after_seconds": 60 }, "request_id": "..." }
```
* Base your UI logic on **`error.code`**, because it never changes. Show `message` to users.
* `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) → `error.details` is `[{ "field": "password", "rule": "strong_password", "message": "..." }]`. Show each message next to its form field.
* On **429**, read `retry_after_seconds` (also the `Retry-After` header) and show a countdown.
* Send `request_id` with bug reports.

## Tourist sign-up flow
1. `POST /auth/register/user/send-otp` `{email}` → show the OTP screen with a resend timer (`resend_after_seconds`)
2. `POST /auth/register/user/verify-otp` `{email, otp}` → keep `data.token` in memory
3. `POST /auth/register/user/complete` `{registration_token, full_name, password?, country_code?}` → **logged in**
4. If `user.onboarding.next_step == "complete_profile"` → `PATCH /users/me/profile` (`country_code` is required)

**Google / Apple:** `POST /auth/oauth/google` or `/auth/oauth/apple` with `{id_token}` → **logged in** (`is_new_user` tells you whether to show the welcome or onboarding screens).

## Guide sign-up flow
1. `POST /auth/register/guide/send-otp` `{phone: "01712345678"}`
2. `POST /auth/register/guide/verify-otp` `{phone, otp}` → `data.token`
3. `POST /auth/register/guide/complete` `{registration_token, full_name, password}` → **logged in**
4. `PATCH /users/me/profile` (`date_of_birth`, `city`, ...) and `PUT /users/me/avatar`
5. `PUT /guides/me/profile` (headline, about, languages, service areas, rate)
6. `POST /guides/me/verification` (multipart: `nid_number`, `nid_front`, `nid_back`, `selfie`)
7. Admin approves → `verification_status = approved` → the guide appears in `GET /guides`

Use **`user.onboarding.next_step`** to route screens:
`complete_profile` → `submit_verification` → `awaiting_review` → (`resubmit_verification`) → `done`.
`onboarding.missing_fields` lists exactly which fields are missing.

## Tokens
* `access_token` is a JWT that expires in `expires_in_seconds` (default 15 min). Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
* `refresh_token` is opaque and lasts 30 days. **It rotates on every refresh**, so always save the new one.
* Web clients should keep the refresh token in memory or secure storage, never in `localStorage` if you can avoid it. Mobile clients should use Keychain or Keystore.
* 401 `TOKEN_INVALID` → call `POST /auth/token/refresh` once, then retry. 401 `REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID` or `SESSION_REVOKED` → go to login.
* 409 `REFRESH_TOKEN_ROTATED` → another tab already refreshed. Re-read the stored token and retry.

## Security (what the frontend will notice)
* **Rate limits** are enforced per IP (global, auth, OTP send) and per user (uploads). A request over the limit gets 429 `RATE_LIMITED`.
* **OTP:** each code is valid for 5 minutes and can be used once. You can request a new code after 60 seconds, up to 5 per hour per email or phone. After 5 wrong attempts that email or phone is blocked for `USER_BLOCK_TIME`.
* **Login lockout:** after `USER_MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS` wrong passwords, the account gets `ACCOUNT_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED` for `USER_BLOCK_TIME`.
* **Captcha:** when enabled, send a Cloudflare Turnstile token in the `X-Captcha-Token` header on send-otp, login and forgot-password requests.
* Forgot-password and OTP-login return the same response whether or not the account exists.

get.description:
Current API version, build (version, git commit, build time) and all available versions.
Every response also carries an `X-API-Version` header. Deprecated versions add
`Deprecation: true` and `Sunset: <date>` headers. Use it to check the server is up.
Oldest first. Default: all statuses; use `status=pending` for the queue.
Document URLs expire after 10 minutes. Every view is written to the audit log.
get.summary: KYC detail (decrypted NID + signed document URLs)

post.description: The reason is shown to the guide, who can fix it and resubmit.

put.description:
Total gigs allowed = FREE_GIG_LIMIT + extra_slots. Until online slot purchase exists, admins
grant slots after the guide pays (keep the payment reference in `note`).
put.summary: Grant extra gig slots to a guide

post.summary: Reject a payment (booking goes back to unpaid)

patch.summary: Hide / show a review (ratings are recalculated)

patch.description:
Moderators can manage divisions, districts, upazilas and tourist spots (/manage/*).
Only `user` ⇄ `moderator` is allowed; guide and admin accounts cannot change role.
The user is signed out everywhere and must log in again to get the new role.
patch.summary: Make a user a moderator (or back to tourist)

patch.description: Suspending signs the user out of every device immediately.

post.description:
`identifier` = email (tourists) or BD mobile (guides). Wrong password returns
`INVALID_CREDENTIALS` with `details.remaining_attempts`. After USER_MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS
failures within USER_FAILED_ATTEMPT_WINDOW the account is locked for USER_BLOCK_TIME
(`ACCOUNT_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED`, 429 + `retry_after_seconds`). Response time is identical
whether or not the account exists.

Sends a code to a verified email (tourist) or BD phone (guide). Always returns the same
response whether or not the account exists (prevents account enumeration).

post.summary: Passwordless login · Step 2 — verify OTP and log in

post.description: Revokes the current session; the access token stops working immediately.

Send the `id_token` (identityToken) from Sign in with Apple. Apple gives the user's name to the
client only on the first sign-in — forward it in `full_name`. Supports private relay emails.

Send the `id_token` (credential) from Google Identity Services (web) or Google Sign-In (mobile).
Creates a tourist account on first use (`is_new_user: true`) or links to an existing account
with the same verified email. The token audience must be one of GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS.
Sends a code to the verified email/phone. Same response whether or not the account exists.
post.summary: Forgot password · Step 1 — send reset OTP

post.description: Sets the new password, signs out every device and clears any login lock. Then log in again.
post.summary: Forgot password · Step 3 — set new password

post.description: `token` is valid for USER_PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRE_IN and can be used once.
post.summary: Forgot password · Step 2 — verify OTP, get reset_token

post.description:
Creates the guide account (verification_status = `unverified`) and logs in.
Next steps (see `user.onboarding`): PATCH /users/me/profile + PUT /users/me/avatar →
PUT /guides/me/profile → POST /guides/me/verification → admin approval → profile goes live.
post.summary: Guide sign-up · Step 3 — create guide account

post.description:
Accepts `01XXXXXXXXX`, `8801XXXXXXXXX` or `+8801XXXXXXXXX`. Only BD mobile operators are
allowed (prevents international SMS fraud). Also limited to SMS_MAX_PER_IP_PER_DAY per IP.
post.summary: Guide sign-up · Step 1 — send SMS OTP (Bangladeshi numbers only)
Guide sign-up · Step 2 — verify SMS OTP

post.description:
Creates the tourist account and logs in (returns tokens). `password` is optional: without
it the tourist signs in with email OTP or Google/Apple. Then follow `user.onboarding.next_step`.

Sends a 6-digit code to the email. Fails with `EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED` (409) if the email
already has an account (send the user to login). Re-sending is allowed after
`resend_after_seconds`; otherwise `OTP_COOLDOWN` (429, see `retry_after_seconds`).
Requires `X-Captcha-Token` header when captcha is enabled.
post.summary: Tourist sign-up · Step 1 — send email OTP

post.description:
Returns a single-use `token` (registration_token) valid for USER_REGISTRATION_TOKEN_EXPIRE_IN.
Keep it in memory and send it with step 3. Wrong codes return `OTP_INVALID` with
`details.remaining_attempts`; after OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS the email is blocked for USER_BLOCK_TIME
(`ACCOUNT_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED`, 429).
post.summary: Tourist sign-up · Step 2 — verify email OTP

post.description:
Call when an API returns 401 `TOKEN_INVALID`, or shortly before `expires_in_seconds`.
The old refresh token becomes invalid — always store the new one. Re-using an old refresh
token (theft) revokes the session. If two tabs refresh at once, the loser gets
`REFRESH_TOKEN_ROTATED` (409): re-read the newest token from storage and retry.

Tourist accounts only. The price is fixed at booking time (`per_person` × group size or `per_group`).
Payment is NOT taken now: it opens after the guide marks the tour completed (`can_pay`).

get.description:
Visible to the tourist, the guide and admins. Contact details of the other side appear once the
guide accepts. `can_*` flags tell the UI which buttons to show.

post.summary: Cancel a booking (tourist or guide, while pending/accepted)

post.description: Allowed on/after the tour date. Opens payment and review for the tourist.

Only after the tour is completed (`can_pay`). `amount` must equal `total_amount`. The payment stays
`pending` until an admin verifies it; then the booking's `payment_status` becomes `paid`.
post.summary: Submit a mobile-banking payment for a completed tour

post.description:
multipart/form-data. Only the tourist of a **completed** booking, once. `rating` 1-5, optional
`comment` (max 2000) and up to 5 `images` (JPEG/PNG/WEBP). Updates gig, guide and spot ratings.

get.description: Each district has `latitude`/`longitude` (for map markers) and `spot_count` (published tourist spots).
get.summary: List districts (জেলা) — all 64 or one division's
Get a district by ID or slug

get.description: One call for cascading dropdowns (≈ 60 KB, cached). Use the list endpoints for large screens.

Filter by `district_id` for a cascading dropdown. Includes Dhaka & Chattogram metropolitan
thanas (`type = metro_thana`). Default limit 100, max 600.

Only active gigs of verified, available guides on published spots. Use `spot_id` on a tourist
spot page ("guides for this place"), `guide_id` on a guide profile.
`quota.remaining = 0` → show "get more slots" (FREE_GIG_LIMIT free gigs, default 5; extra slots are paid, coming later).

post.description:
Verified guides only (KYC approved). One gig per tourist spot. Price is whole BDT,
`per_person` (× group size) or `per_group`. Returns 402 GIG_LIMIT_REACHED (with the quota in
`error.details`) when all slots are used.
post.summary: Create a gig for a tourist spot

patch.description: Pause with `{"status":"paused"}`, resume with `{"status":"active"}`. Suspended gigs cannot be edited.
patch.summary: Update my gig (partial) — price, hours, group size, languages, status...

get.description: Only approved, active and available guides are listed. Contact info is never exposed.

put.description:
Full replace (PUT). Either `hourly_rate` or `daily_rate` is required (BDT, whole taka).
`languages`: ISO 639-1 codes (bn, en, hi...). `service_areas`: lowercase slugs (dhaka, sylhet,
coxs-bazar...). `specialties`: see GET /guides/options.

post.description:
multipart/form-data. Allowed only when `onboarding.next_step` is `submit_verification` or
`resubmit_verification` (profile must be complete, see `GUIDE_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE.details`).
Images: JPEG/PNG/WEBP, max MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB each, min 300x300. Documents are stored privately
(never public URLs) and the NID number is encrypted (AES-256-GCM). An admin reviews it;
the guide gets an SMS with the result.

delete.summary: Delete a district (only when nothing references it)

post.description: `slug` is generated from `name` when omitted.

delete.summary: Delete a division (only when it has no districts)
Delete an upazila / thana (only when no tourist spot uses it)

get.summary: List all tourist spots (drafts, published, archived)

post.description:
Admins and moderators. Images can be URLs here (e.g. from autofill) and/or uploaded later via
POST /manage/tourist-spots/{id}/images. The first image becomes the cover. `status` defaults to `draft`.
`google_map_url` is generated from the coordinates when omitted.

Type a name (e.g. "Ratargul Swamp Forest") and get a ready draft: description, highlights,
coordinates, Google Maps link, photos, YouTube videos, suggested upazilas (nearest to the
coordinates) and category. Nothing is saved — review it, then POST `data.draft` to /manage/tourist-spots.
Wikipedia is always used; YouTube, Google image search and AI writing need their API keys
(see `data.notes`).
post.summary: Auto-fill a tourist spot from its name (Wikipedia / Google / YouTube / AI)

delete.description: Refused while guides have gigs for it (archive it with status=archived instead).

patch.description:
Only sent fields change. `upazila_ids`, `images`, `videos` replace the whole list when sent.
Publish / unpublish with `{"status":"published"}` or `{"status":"draft"}`.

post.description:
multipart/form-data, repeat the `images` field for several files (JPEG/PNG/WEBP, max
MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB each, min 400x400). Optional `captions` in the same order. Max 50 images per spot.

delete.summary: Remove one image from a tourist spot

250 countries sorted by name: ISO code (send it as `country_code`), dial code, emoji and
flag image URLs from the free flagcdn.com CDN. Cached for a day.

Grid/search for tourists. Filter by division, district (also matches spots that span a
district through a second upazila), upazila, category, featured or free text.

Every published spot with coordinates, cover image, title and rating — enough for the

get.summary: Map markers for the Bangladesh map

get.description:
Full page: description, highlights, all images (1-50), YouTube videos (with embed/thumbnail
URLs), upazilas/thanas, Google Maps link. Accepts the UUID or the slug.

after login (complete_profile | submit_verification | awaiting_review | resubmit_verification | done).

`password` is required when the account has one.

The file type is detected from its content, not its name.

post.description:
`current_password` is required when `has_password` is true. Google/Apple-only accounts can
set a first password without it. All other devices are signed out.

patch.description:
PATCH semantics — send only the fields that changed. Empty string clears an optional field.
Tourists must set `country_code` to finish onboarding. Guides must set `date_of_birth`
(18+), `city` and an avatar. A verified guide cannot change `date_of_birth`.
